name.description: Name of the distributed port group as it will appear in vCenter inventory. This is the value to pass as network_name to the compute modules.

datacenter.description: Name of the vCenter datacenter that contains the target inventory.

distributed_switch.description: Name of the vSphere distributed virtual switch that the port group is created on.

vlan_id.description: VLAN ID applied to the port group. Use 0 for no VLAN tagging, which is the normal choice for a fully isolated exercise segment.

number_of_ports.description: Number of ports to pre-allocate on the port group. Size this above the number of adapters you expect to attach.

allow_promiscuous.description: Allow adapters on this segment to receive traffic not addressed to them. Required for packet capture, IDS sensors and span-style monitoring.

allow_spoofing.description: Allow forged transmits and MAC address changes on this segment. Required for routers that NAT or bridge, and for attack tooling that spoofs addresses.

annotation.description: Free-form notes recorded on the port group description.
